questions.title: Zoho L1 Written Test Format
questions.question: Round 1 is a pen-and-paper test: about 10 aptitude questions plus 10-15 code snippets (C, C++ or Java depending on drive) where you write the exact output. No options are given; cut-offs are high (often 18+/20). Snippets focus on pointers, static/global variables, recursion, loops, strings, enums and arrays.
